text: We are a manufacturer in Melbourne looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

result.keyword: We are a manufacturer in Melbourne looking to automate order processing, shop-floor data capture, and operations without replacing our ERP. Which automation and Power Platform consultants should we speak to?

items.markdown:
When you want to layer automation, shop-floor data capture, and process orchestration on top of an existing ERP without ripping and replacing it, the `Microsoft Power Platform` (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio) is an ideal "glue."

For a Melbourne-based manufacturer, you should look for consulting partners who understand operational technology (OT), shop-floor realities (shift work, rugged devices, offline capabilities), and complex ERP integration patterns (via standard connectors, custom APIs, or data gateways).[[1]](https://eagle360.consulting/microsoft-power-platform-partner-in-australia/)[[2]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)

Specialist and experienced partners to consider include:

1. **Inturing** 
	- **Focus:** Dedicated [Inturing Power Platform for Manufacturing](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing) consulting, implementation, and optimization across Australia.
	- **Why them:** They specialize heavily in manufacturing operational workflows—building shop-floor Power Apps, automated approval loops, production tracking dashboards, and digital quality/safety audit trails that cleanly layer over existing enterprise systems.[[1]](https://www.inturing.com.au/manufacturing)
2. **Eagle360 Consulting** 
	- **Focus:** Microsoft partner with a strong presence in Melbourne and Sydney specializing in low-code architecture, Dataverse, and governed Power Platform solutions.
	- **Why them:** They excel at mid-market integration and structured deployments (including fixed-price scope frameworks), ensuring that your shop-floor apps and automated flows talk securely to your databases and ERP backbones without creating shadow-IT nightmares.[[1]](https://eagle360.consulting/microsoft-power-platform-partner-in-australia/)
3. **C9 (C9 Partners / C9 Power Platform Automation)** 
	- **Focus:** Process automation and enterprise low-code integration servicing Melbourne organizations.
	- **Why them:** They focus on heavy-duty Power Automate workflow orchestration and data consolidation, connecting disparate systems, legacy tools, and Microsoft 365 environments into cohesive operational layers.[[1]](https://www.c9.com.au/Melbourne/Process-Automation/Power-Platform-Power-Automate)
4. **Local Enterprise / Boutique Microsoft Gold Partners** 
	- *Note:* Larger national/global tier-1 Microsoft partners (such as Avanade, Empired/Telstra Purple, or Velrada) also have massive Melbourne practices, though they typically target larger enterprise transformations. For mid-market manufacturing, specialized boutique firms often provide faster turnaround and pragmatic, shop-floor-friendly designs.

To help narrow down which of these consultants matches your setup best, could you share:

- What **ERP system** are you currently running?
- What specific **shop-floor data capture** challenges are you facing first (e.g., paper-based work orders, barcode scanning, machine data)?
